title: LSP connection forcibly closes
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.10 GiB memory

### Issue description

Neovim LSP setup:
```
vim.lsp.config.gdscript = {
        name = 'godot',
        cmd = {
          'ncat',
          '--keep-open',
          '127.0.0.1',
          '6005',
        },
        root_markers = { 'project.godot' },
        capabilities = capabilities,
}
```

Nvim's LSP log contains the following:
```
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:03:39] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:05:40] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:07:41] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:09:43] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:12:43] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:14:44] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:16:45] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[START][2025-12-02 21:19:22] LSP logging initiated
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:19:22] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:21:38] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
[ERROR][2025-12-02 21:23:39] ...p/_transport.lua:36	"rpc"	"ncat"	"stderr"	"Ncat: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host. .\r\n"
```

Many instances of it occur since I wrote a script to automatically reconnect once it has been dropped, but it is annoying regardless. This is the only output from the Godot editor:

```
[LSP] Connection Taken
[LSP] Disconnected
[LSP] Connection Taken
[LSP] Disconnected
[LSP] Connection Taken
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create gdscript file
2. Open in gdscript file in neovim
3. Wait for ~30 seconds
